title: unify sdks: auth/retries/streaming parity + ergonomics improvements
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Improvements to SDK auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; parity fixes and version bumps.
description: Motivation: unify auth/retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across the three official SDKs (python/typescript/go) to reduce production confusion and make behavior predictable under transient errors. This PR implements consistent token refresh hooks, standardized retry backoff defaults, and a more ergonomic streaming API surface with identical event types across languages. Changes are intentionally backward-compatible for the main call shapes; a single explicit opt-in toggles the new streaming convenience helpers. What changed: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh handler and expose a per-client RefreshPolicy with a pluggable Async/Sync hook; ensure token refresh is retried with jitter on 401/403 when refresh is rate-limited. 2) Retries: align default retry counts and exponential backoff windows across SDKs, add idempotency-safe retry for non-streaming requests, and surface retryable error classes in public types. 3) Streaming: add StreamingClient/Stream object with on_event/on_error/on_complete callbacks and a helper to convert streams to async iterators in Python/TS and channels in Go; keep raw lower-level envelope for advanced users. 4) Parity fixes: bring argument names, error constants, and semantic behaviors in line with the TypeScript SDK which is the reference in this change. 5) Version bumps: python -> 1.8.0, typescript -> 0.22.0, go -> v0.9.1. Backwards compatibility: old constructors remain supported but emit a deprecation warning for the convenience streaming helper; default retry/backoff windows are slightly adjusted but within previously documented ranges. Tests and validation: added unit and integration tests for token refresh under concurrency, retry behavior on transient gRPC/http errors, and streaming end-to-end smoke-tests with local canary runtime; updated changelogs and examples. Checklist: [x] unit tests added/updated [x] integration smoke-tests [x] SDK docs updated [x] changelogs and version bumps [x] compatibility notes added. Related: ENG-4123 (SDK unification), ENG-4210 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-987 (customer report on inconsistent retries).

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Please confirm that the RefreshPolicy hook is safe for sync and async call sites; looks like the python implementation uses an async-only path.
Ava Chen: Reply: added SyncRefreshPolicy shim in python and tests to validate sync client usage; TS/Go already supported both styles via callback/chan patterns.
Priya Patel: Can we avoid a breaking rename for the streaming callbacks? on_event is fine but call site churn may be non-trivial.
Ava Chen: Reply: preserved old names behind a small compatibility wrapper that emits a deprecation warning for one release cycle; updated examples.
Samir Kapoor: LGTM after CI green. Minor nits inline about doc wording around idempotency semantics.

notes_for_release: SDKs: aligned auth refresh and retry defaults; added new streaming convenience helpers and maintained backward compatibility via wrappers; bumped python to 1.8.0, typescript to 0.22.0, go to v0.9.1. See docs/sdk-auth-retries.md for migration notes.
